audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar silver-trumpet and Sinai-departure text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for assembly signals, journey alarms, war remembrance, festival trumpets, departure order, Hobab invitation, ark guidance, and Moses' rise/rest prayers. Anti-militarization and anti-coercion safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Make for yourself two silver trumpets; hammered work you shall make them. They shall be for summoning congregation and for setting out camps.

familiar.text: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

modern.text: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.

original.text: עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְךָ֗ שְׁתֵּי֙ חֲצֽוֹצְרֹ֣ת כֶּ֔סֶף מִקְשָׁ֖ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לְךָ֙ לְמִקְרָ֣א הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וּלְמַסַּ֖ע אֶת הַֽמַּחֲנֽוֹת

verses.restored: When they blow both, whole congregation shall assemble to you at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְתָקְע֖וּ בָּהֵ֑ן וְנֽוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ כָּל הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: If they blow one, leaders, heads of thousands of Israel, shall assemble to you.

familiar.text: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

modern.text: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.

original.text: וְאִם בְּאַחַ֖ת יִתְקָ֑עוּ וְנוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: When you sound alarm/blast, camps camping eastward shall set out.

familiar.text: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

modern.text: When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.

original.text: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֑ה וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים קֵֽדְמָה

verses.restored: When you sound second alarm/blast, camps camping southward shall set out; alarm/blast shall be sounded for their journeys.

familiar.text: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

modern.text: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.

original.text: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֤ם תְּרוּעָה֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים תֵּימָ֑נָה תְּרוּעָ֥ה יִתְקְע֖וּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: But when assembly is gathered, you shall blow, but not sound alarm/blast.

familiar.text: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

modern.text: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.

original.text: וּבְהַקְהִ֖יל אֶת הַקָּהָ֑ל תִּתְקְע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָרִֽיעוּ

verses.restored: Sons of Aaron, priests, shall blow trumpets; they shall be for you as age-long statute throughout generations.

familiar.text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

modern.text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.

original.text: וּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּֽחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: When you go to war in your land against adversary oppressing you, you shall sound alarm with trumpets, and you shall be remembered before YHWH your Divine and delivered from your enemies.

familiar.text: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

modern.text: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.

original.text: וְכִֽי תָבֹ֨אוּ מִלְחָמָ֜ה בְּאַרְצְכֶ֗ם עַל הַצַּר֙ הַצֹּרֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֔ם וַהֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם בַּחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וֲנִזְכַּרְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְנוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֖ם מֵאֹיְבֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: On days of your gladness, at appointed times, and at beginnings of months, you shall blow trumpets over burnt offerings and sacrifices of peace/well-being; they shall be for you as remembrance before your Divine. I am YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

modern.text: And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.” From Sinai to Paran

original.text: וּבְי֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֥ם וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮ וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י חָדְשֵׁיכֶם֒ וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: In second year, in second month, on twentieth of month, cloud lifted from over dwelling-place of testimony.

familiar.text: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

modern.text: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony,

original.text: וַיְהִ֞י בַּשָּׁנָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ נַעֲלָה֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן מֵעַ֖ל מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת

verses.restored: Children of Israel set out by their journeys from wilderness of Sinai, and cloud settled in wilderness of Paran.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

modern.text: and the Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran.

original.text: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן הֶעָנָ֖ן בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן

verses.restored: They set out first at mouth/command of YHWH by hand of Moses.

familiar.text: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

modern.text: They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses.

original.text: וַיִּסְע֖וּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: Standard of camp of sons of Judah set out first by their hosts, and over his host was Nahshon son of Amminadab.

familiar.text: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

modern.text: First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.

original.text: וַיִּסַּ֞ע דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֛ה בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל צְבָא֔וֹ נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָֽב

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Issachar was Nethanel son of Zuar.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

modern.text: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,

original.text: וְעַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּעָֽר

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Zebulun was Eliab son of Helon.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

modern.text: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.

original.text: וְעַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֑ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן חֵלֽוֹן

verses.restored: Dwelling-place was taken down, and sons of Gershon and sons of Merari set out carrying dwelling-place.

familiar.text: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

modern.text: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.

original.text: וְהוּרַ֖ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן וְנָסְע֤וּ בְנֵֽי גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ וּבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: Standard of camp of Reuben set out by their hosts, and over his host was Elizur son of Shedeur.

familiar.text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

modern.text: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.

original.text: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Simeon was Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

modern.text: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,

original.text: וְעַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן שְׁלֻֽמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Gad was Eliasaph son of Deuel.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

modern.text: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.

original.text: וְעַל צְבָ֖א מַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי גָ֑ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵֽל

verses.restored: Kohathites set out carrying holy things, and dwelling-place was set up before they arrived.

familiar.text: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

modern.text: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.

original.text: וְנָסְעוּ֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְהֵקִ֥ימוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עַד בֹּאָֽם

verses.restored: Standard of camp of sons of Ephraim set out by their hosts, and over his host was Elishama son of Ammihud.

familiar.text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

modern.text: Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim set out under their standard, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.

original.text: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Manasseh was Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

modern.text: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,

original.text: וְעַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן פְּדָה צֽוּר

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Benjamin was Abidan son of Gideoni.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

modern.text: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.

original.text: וְעַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן גִּדְעוֹנִֽי

verses.restored: Standard of camp of sons of Dan set out as rear guard of all camps by their hosts, and over his host was Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

familiar.text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

modern.text: Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard, serving as the rear guard for all units, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.

original.text: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֚גֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי דָ֔ן מְאַסֵּ֥ף לְכָל הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֖ת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל צְבָא֔וֹ אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Asher was Pagiel son of Ocran.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

modern.text: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,

original.text: וְעַל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֑ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן

verses.restored: Over host of tribe of sons of Naphtali was Ahira son of Enan.

familiar.text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

modern.text: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.

original.text: וְעַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֑י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן עֵינָֽן

verses.restored: These were settings-out of children of Israel by their hosts; so they set out.

familiar.text: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

modern.text: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.

original.text: אֵ֛לֶּה מַסְעֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וַיִּסָּֽעוּ

verses.restored: Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, relative/in-law of Moses: We are setting out to place of which YHWH said, I will give it to you. Come with us, and we will do good to you, for YHWH has spoken good concerning Israel.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

modern.text: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ֠חֹבָב בֶּן רְעוּאֵ֣ל הַמִּדְיָנִי֮ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֒ נֹסְעִ֣ים אֲנַ֗חְנוּ אֶל הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֹת֖וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם לְכָ֤ה אִתָּ֨נוּ֙ וְהֵטַ֣בְנוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה דִּבֶּר ט֖וֹב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He said to him, I will not go, but to my land and my kindred I will go.

familiar.text: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

modern.text: “I will not go,” Hobab replied. “Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו לֹ֣א אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּ֧י אִם אֶל אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י אֵלֵֽךְ

verses.restored: Moses said, Please do not leave us, for you know our camping in wilderness and you can be to us as eyes.

familiar.text: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

modern.text: “Please do not leave us,” Moses said, “since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.

original.text: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַל נָ֖א תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י עַל כֵּ֣ן יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֲנֹתֵ֨נוּ֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְעֵינָֽיִם

verses.restored: If you go with us, then the good with which YHWH does good to us, we will do good to you.

familiar.text: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

modern.text: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”

original.text: וְהָיָ֖ה כִּי תֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיָ֣ה הַטּ֣וֹב הַה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵיטִ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה עִמָּ֖נוּ וְהֵטַ֥בְנוּ לָֽךְ

verses.restored: They set out from mountain of YHWH a journey of three days, and ark of covenant of YHWH journeyed before them a journey of three days to seek out rest for them.

familiar.text: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

modern.text: So they set out on a three-day journey from the mountain of the LORD, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them for those three days to seek a resting place for them.

original.text: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵהַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַאֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֜ה נֹסֵ֣עַ לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים לָת֥וּר לָהֶ֖ם מְנוּחָֽה

verses.restored: Cloud of YHWH was over them by day when they set out from camp.

familiar.text: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

modern.text: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.

original.text: וַעֲנַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם בְּנָסְעָ֖ם מִן הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה

verses.restored: When ark set out, Moses said: Rise, YHWH, and let your enemies be scattered; let those hating you flee before you.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

modern.text: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say, “Rise up, O LORD! May Your enemies be scattered; may those who hate You flee before You.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֛י בִּנְסֹ֥עַ הָאָרֹ֖ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וְיָפֻ֨צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔יךָ וְיָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: When it rested, he said: Return, YHWH, to myriads of thousands of Israel.

familiar.text: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.

modern.text: And when it came to rest, he would say: “Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”

original.text: וּבְנֻחֹ֖ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה רִֽבְב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

translation_notes: The trumpets distinguish assembly, travel, alarm, celebration, and worship; sound organizes communal attention.
War language belongs to ancient Israel's land-conflict setting and must not be generalized into religious militarism or aggression.
Tribal departure follows the camp order of Numbers 2 and the transport duties of Numbers 4.
Hobab is invited because of wilderness knowledge; his stated refusal must not be erased. Moses asks again and offers shared good rather than ownership.
The ark seeks rest for the people, and Moses' paired prayers hold movement and return together.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 10 to glorify war, force outsiders into the community, or confuse religious signals with unquestionable political commands. Its strongest pattern is coordinated movement, shared expertise, remembrance, celebration, and Presence seeking rest for the people.
